comments_text: Discovery: scorpion venom peptide library screen. Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is most similar (61.54%) to frog Temporin-SHc F=L: 33%. GRAVY: 1.33; mol Wt: 1098.352; mol formula: C57H84N10O11; mol ex coeff: 0. Activity: active against S. aureus AB94004 or ATCC25923 or ATCC6538 (MIC 11.38 uM), E. coli AB94012 or ATCC25922 or DH5alpha (MIC 45.52 uM), and P. aeruginosa ATCC9027 or PAO1 (MIC 45.52-91.04 uM). Virus: inhibits hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection (EC50 1.84 ug/ml). In vitro Toxicity: Huh7.5.1 cells (TC50 79.8 ug/ml). MOA:virus: it inactivated infectious viral particles.
